look_here_first: Scrambling unarmed vine with purple star flowers, green-white eye spots, often lobed leaves, and bright red berries.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Kew accepts the species but treats it as native to Eurasia/North Africa, not Texas.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Included for visual learning; native metrics excluded unless later exact-county review supports inclusion.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Solanaceae/Solanum: alternate leaves, 5-parted rotate/stellate corollas, poricidal anthers, and berry fruits.
best_field_traits: green-white shiny spots at corolla lobe bases
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Closest visual match here is S. triquetrum because both can scramble and have red berries. S. dulcamara has purple flowers and more ovate/lobed leaves; S. triquetrum has white flowers and sharply triangular leaves.
